responsibility: Implements SHORTINT and SHORTCARD text I/O over channels using scanner-driven decimal parsing and string-based formatting. It skips leading spaces, drives WholeConv scanners character by character through TextIO, accumulates short numeric values directly while handling sign and simple range checks, and formats output through StringConvert plus StringChan, making it the short-width whole-number parsing/printing layer in the ISO I/O family.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable implementation of the ShortWholeIO interface declared in ShortWholeIO.def, providing the actual WholeConv/TextIO-based parsing and StringConvert/StringChan-based formatting logic rather than just the exported procedure signatures.
